# Golden output of src/ui/theme/ColorSchemes.qml, captured from the QML
# implementation (Qt 6.11) before the palette moved to Rust. One line per
# case:
#   catalog defaultId=.. defaultIntensity=.. ids=<comma list in picker order>
#   effective id=<id> value=<effective id> light=<bool> preview=<3 hex>
#   palette id=<id> intensity=<name> <role>=<hex> ... (27 roles, Theme.qml order)
# Colors are what String(color) yields in QML: #rrggbb, or #aarrggbb for the
# scrim. `not-a-preset` and `not-an-intensity` exercise the fallbacks.
# zaparoo_app::palette must reproduce every value exactly.
#
# Regenerate: a temporary QML TestCase that console.warn()s these lines for
# ColorSchemes.ids plus "not-a-preset", run with
# build/tests/ui/tst_ui -input <file> -platform offscreen (release builds
# drop console.log). See docs/plans/slint-migration.md, step 2.
